fusions.name: Spat Dregs
fusions.desc: Spits the strained-out dregs in a cone 5 tiles ahead, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and leaves each enemy [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Backwash
fusions.desc: Draws one of your afflictions back out of an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Baleen Sieve
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Ambergris
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. Your poison resistance rises by 10%.
